entities.name: Warda El- Djazairia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Warda Mohammed Ftouki, known professionally as Warda Al-Jazairia, was an Algerian singer. She was well known for her Egyptian Arabic songs and music. Her name was sometimes shortened to just Warda in the Arab world.
